controller_decision: One bounded attempt after scoped independent v2 and v3 restriction reviews. Runtime approval means the observed essential installation is trusted under the policy below, not a claim that compute comparison already passed.
runtime_trust_policy: Trust wyim-owned p-wyim-only-group installation and ordinary site administrators. No installation, upgrade or environment edits by this workflow during the attempt. Compute must compare the pinned closure; controller must rehash enumerated runtime files after work. Not malicious-same-UID resistance.
containment_scope: Only reviewed site-v1 hierarchy permitted. Actual job PID, four-CPU affinity, hierarchical 4GiB RAM and combined memsw are verified before alignment; unknown layout refuses. Terminal batch/extern and reaping remain acceptance checks.
final_acceptance: Require verified fixed oracle and declared seams, final stdout/receipt/marker identities, no FAILED, source/input/runtime preservation, output and scheduler log logical/allocated sizes within reviewed threshold, and clean terminal job/batch/extern accounting. Any unexplained extern OOM rejects clean fixture acceptance; retain workload diagnostics separately.
